Class OpenApiAuthenticationInterceptor

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.spring.call.CallHandlerInterceptor
com.sca4d.openapi.web.OpenApiAuthenticationInterceptor
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.web.servlet.HandlerInterceptor
public class OpenApiAuthenticationInterceptor extends com.sca4d.core.spring.call.CallHandlerInterceptor
在通用认证拦截器前恢复 OpenAPI 独立 JWT 或验证 OpenAPI MAC 请求。
